events.strDescriptionEN:
The 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix (officially known as the Formula 1 Gran Premio de la Ciudad de México 2026) was a Formula One motor race that was held on 1 November 2026 at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez in Mexico City, Mexico. It was the ninteenth round of the 2026 Formula One World Championship.

Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari) took his first pole position since the 2023 Hungarian Grand Prix, and his first pole position with the team. Kimi Antonelli clinched his first Formula One World Drivers' Championship after achieving third. Antonelli became the youngest Drivers' Champion at the age of 20 years, 2 months and 8 days, beating the previous record holder Sebastian Vettel, the first Italian Drivers' Champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953, and Mercedes' first Drivers' Championship since Hamilton secured his seventh title in 2020. Ahead of him, Max Verstappen (Red Bull) won the race and Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari) finished second in an eventful race. This Grand Prix also saw Ryo Hirakawa make his Formula One Grand Prix debut with Haas, where he benefitted from drivers ahead of him receiving penalties to score his first Formula One points.
